FIRST_BUY.title: Fractional investing in action
FIRST_BUY.text: A small investment buys part of a share. Start with ₹10–₹500, track the price, and see how your virtual holdings change over time. These are simulated prices, so no real shares or money change hands.

LOSS_SALE.title: Learning from a sale at a loss
LOSS_SALE.text: You sold below your average purchase price. Prices can fall as well as rise. Review why you bought, consider your time horizon, and avoid making decisions from a single short-term price change.

DIVERSIFICATION.title: Building a varied portfolio
DIVERSIFICATION.text: You now hold at least three different stocks. Spreading investments across businesses and sectors can reduce dependence on one company, although diversification cannot remove all risk.
